defs.def: one of the parts of the body of a bird, insect or bat that it uses for flying （鸟、昆虫或蝙蝠）翅膀，翼

ex.s: I removed the sticky spider-webs that covered her head and wings.
ex.t: 我清除覆盖在她头部和翅膀上的粘性蜘蛛网。

ex.s: It’s true, the older I get, the more I feel time has wings.
ex.t: 没错，我年纪越大，越觉得时间有翅膀。

ex.s: Every autumn, millions of these beautiful insects with fine black and orange wings begin a long and difficult journey.
ex.t: 每年秋天，数以百万计这些长着黑橙相间美丽翅膀的昆虫开始一段漫长而艰难的旅程。

ex.s: Its features are as white as snow, except for some black ones on its face, neck and wings.
ex.t: 它的面貌白如雪，除了脸部、脖子和翅膀上的一些黑色部分。

ex.s: The intricately fashioned objects that have stood still for centuries instantly come back to life: water flows, boats sail, dogs bark, chickens flap their wings and a woman starts to spin.
ex.t: 那些历经数百年静止不动的、制作精巧的物品，瞬间焕发了生机：水流了起来，船划了起来，狗叫了起来，鸡扇动着翅膀，一个女人开始纺纱。

ex.s: That huge sculpture you can see is the Winged Victory of Samothrace, or Nike of Samothrace!
ex.t: 你可以看到那巨大的雕塑 是萨摩太的胜利之翼 或萨摩太的耐克！

defs.def: one of the large flat parts that stick out from the side of a plane and help to keep it in the air when it is flying （飞行器的）翅膀；机翼

ex.s: The vehicle — named the Transition – has two seats, four wheels and wings that fold up so it can be driven like a car.
ex.t: 这辆名为Transition的车有两个座位、四个轮子和可折叠的机翼，因此可以像汽车一样驾驶。

ex.s: The vehicle-named the Transition – has two seats， four wheels and wings that fold up so it can be driven like a car.
ex.t: 这辆车——名为Transition——有两个座位、四个轮子和可折叠的机翼，因此可以像汽车一样驾驶。

defs.def: one of the parts of a large building that sticks out from the main part 侧翼部分；侧厅；耳房；厢房
a part of a car that is above a wheel 挡泥板；翼子板
one section of an organization that has a particular function or whose members share the same opinions （起某种作用或持相同观点的）派，翼
the far left or right side of the sports field （运动场地的）远端边侧
the area at either side of the stage that cannot be seen by the audience （舞台上观众看不到的）边厢，翼部，侧面

ex.s: I stopped, and she soon took wing but did not immediately fly away.
ex.t: 我停了下来，她很快飞了起来，但没有马上飞走。

defs.def: to be sent somewhere very quickly 被迅速送往

ex.s: The first dish Oliver prepared for his family was fried chicken wings.
ex.t: 奥利弗为家人做的第一道菜是炸鸡翅。
